test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: A train P going at the speed of 70 km/h completely passes train Q of length 170 m, going in the same direction on parallel tracks, at 56 km/h, in 1 (1)/(2) minutes. How much time (in seconds) will P take to cross completely train R of length 220 m, going at 74 km/h in the opposite direction?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Relative Speed** (Same direction) = 70 − 56 = 14 km/h = 14 × (5/18) m/s.

**Total Length** (P + Q) = Speed × Time = (14 × 5/18) × 90 = 350 m.

**Length of P** = 350 − 170 = 180 m.

**Relative Speed** (Opposite direction P & R) = 70 + 74 = 144 km/h = 144 × (5/18) = 40 m/s.

**Time to cross R** = (Length P + Length R) ÷ Speed = (180 + 220) ÷ 40 = 400 ÷ 40 = 10 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/160e151e041a9875151ae9b9252726eaa97e058d1bb683b7308bf54432ad9665.png] 

**Given:** Speed P = 70 km/h, Speed Q = 56 km/h, Length Q = 170 m, Time₁ = 1.5 min = 90 s, Length R = 220 m, Speed R = 74 km/h.

**Formula Used:** Distance = Relative Speed × Time; km/h to m/s conversion = × 5/18.

⇒ Relative Speed (P and Q) = 70 − 56 = 14 km/h = 14 × (5/18) = 70/18 m/s.

⇒ Total Distance = LP + 170 = (70/18) × 90

⇒ LP + 170 = 350

⇒ LP = 180 m.

⇒ Relative Speed (P and R) = 70 + 74 = 144 km/h = 144 × (5/18) = 40 m/s.

⇒ Time taken to cross R = (LP + LR) ÷ Relative Speed = (180 + 220) ÷ 40

⇒ Time = 400 ÷ 40 = 10 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in the **same direction**, relative speed = S₁ − S₂. When they move in **opposite directions**, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.

Crossing Length Rule

Total distance covered while one train crosses another is always the **sum of their lengths** (L₁ + L₂), regardless of direction.

Conversion Units

To convert speed from **km/h to m/s**, multiply by 5/18. To convert **m/s to km/h**, multiply by 18/5.</p
